correctness.rationale: The exact single-spin energy difference is 2 sigma_v(h-J sum_neighbors sigma), so only |h|/J=1,3 alter weak stability. Every labeled circular rung word is in bijection with a length-n closed walk of a precisely constructed 16-state transfer matrix. Exact integer characteristic-polynomial identities at all five field regimes produce each formula, and the primitive 11-state critical component establishes the strict Perron growth root. A standalone standard-library verifier reconstructs matrix coefficients, brute rung words, original Hamiltonian flip energies and critical strong-connectivity/coprime-cycle assertions. These are finite certificates for nonstandard algebraic steps, not numerical proof of a finite-only extrapolation. Limits n>=3, J>0 and weak >=0 stability are explicit.

value.rationale: The width-two cyclic prism is a canonical regular graph for zero-temperature Ising metastability and the classification covers every size n>=3 and every field. The strict-field Lucas regimes and isolated marginal-field nine-root entropy spike at t=1 reveal a discontinuous exponential growth rate of blocked states, not a generic textbook counting exercise or arbitrary small finite census. The known independent-set boundary at t=3 supplies a physically motivated endpoint comparison but is not claimed separately new. The formula can benchmark deterministic low-temperature local-minima structure and update-rule sensitivity to neutral flips without assuming positive-temperature dynamical conclusions.
